# Gustavo Arriaga (arriagagustavoo)

> A one-person design / code studio in Houston, Texas. Gustavo "Gus" Arriaga designs and builds websites and custom software for small businesses, in English and Spanish, and handles graphic design and local SEO.

Computer science senior at the University of Houston (B.S. Computer Science, Software Design). Freelancing since 2026.
Contact: the form at https://arriagagustavoo.com/contact, gus@arriagagustavoo.com, or call/text 832-453-4158.
Spanish version of the site: https://arriagagustavoo.com/es (summary in https://arriagagustavoo.com/llms-es.txt).

## How it works

1. Design: a talk about the business, then a free demo of the site the owner sees before paying anything (the full design is part of the package once they sign on).
2. Build: the site is coded; the client follows progress, files, messages and payments in their own portal.
3. Ship: it goes live; hosting, fixes and small changes every month, no lock-in (30 days' notice either way).

## Packages (approximate; exact price comes from the free estimate and a written quote)

- Starter, from $600 + $45/mo: customers read it. Its own design and motion, works on phones, contact form, readable by Google.
- Standard, about $1,700 + $65/mo: customers do one thing on it (book, order or message), with accounts and a database.
- Premium, about $3,000 + $95/mo: customers do several things, and the owner runs it from a back office (payments, schedules, editing).
- Custom portal, about $2,800 + $120/mo: software the business itself runs on every day.

Add-ons: extra pages, a Spanish version, SEO: Google setup and optimization (Business Profile) and monthly care, tap stands for reviews and socials (custom NFC/QR, quoted), self-editing, logo cleanup, custom design, 3D models and prints.
Payments: half at signing, half at delivery. Two rounds of revisions. The client owns the site, code, content and data once paid. No ranking or sales guarantees.
